direction.thesis: A flexible weapon lets the distal mass hit before the body feels the full consequence. Contact converts slack/flight into pinned tension; the proximal chain then pays a delayed return wave through shoulder, pelvis, support, rebound, counterswing, lag catch, and displaced recovery.
required_read: asymmetric rear coil with visibly slack distal mass
pinned distal while pelvis/handle overrun and tension rises
return wave reaches shoulder after contact
root recoil and widened support catch
distal rebound overshoot after root changes direction
curvature reverses during counterswing without reverse playback
lag catch after body nearly restacks
displaced ready with residual slack rather than idle reset

compile.connective_motion: deterministic linear geometry between authored keys; semantic events remain key-owned

keys.name: CROOKED_READY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Displaced asymmetric ready; distal mass hangs low inside the body envelope with obvious slack.

keys.name: REAR_COIL_SLACK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis compresses rear/down while the handle rises behind the shoulder; distal mass stays low and rearward.

keys.name: HANDLE_COMMIT_MASS_LAGS
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root and handle launch first; distal mass remains behind, making proximal-before-distal causality legible.

keys.name: TAKEUP_GATE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Handle outruns the distal mass; bowed link takes up toward a straight line without claiming contact.

keys.name: TAUT_PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Tether reaches near-straight tension with a clean air gap between distal mass and target plane.

keys.name: DISTAL_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Distal mass hits the target first while pelvis/root still advances; contact is not maximum body extension.

keys.name: PINNED_LOAD_PROXIMAL_OVERRUN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Distal remains pinned at contact while pelvis and handle overrun forward/down, visibly storing delayed tension through the link.

keys.name: RETURN_WAVE_HITS_SHOULDER
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Contact opens as the return wave reaches the proximal chain: shoulders/hands shear visibly forward of the braking pelvis before root recoil begins.

keys.name: ROOT_RECOIL_SUPPORT_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis recoils back/down only after shoulder yank; support widens to catch returned tension while distal rebounds high.

keys.name: DISTAL_REBOUND_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root stops retreating while distal mass continues high/back past the handle, paying momentum debt after the body changes direction.

keys.name: COUNTERSWING_SECONDARY_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Torso restacks while distal mass crosses behind/under the handle; tether curvature reverses without reverse-playing the outgoing swing.

keys.name: LAG_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Hands arrest the returning link after root is mostly stacked; distal mass remains off-axis so recovery still carries visible debt.

keys.name: DISPLACED_READY_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Readiness returns two cells forward with wider support and distal mass still forward-low; no idle reset to K00.

quality_iterations.defect: K07 RETURN_WAVE_HITS_SHOULDER was too visually subtle: distal rebound began, but the proximal shoulder/hand catch barely separated from the pelvis, weakening the delayed-bill thesis.
quality_iterations.correction: Strengthen SAME-body K07 only: shear shoulders/hands/handle forward while pelvis remains braking, then let K08 root recoil follow as a separate consequence.

quality_iterations.basis: Actual decoded key-frame sequence now reads asymmetrical slack coil -> proximal handle lead -> takeup -> taut precontact gap -> distal-first contact -> pinned distal with proximal overrun -> visibly sheared shoulder/hand return-wave catch -> root recoil/wide support catch -> distal rebound overshoot -> counterswing curvature reversal -> late lag catch -> displaced residual-slack ready. No arm-only or idle-reset read remains.

The flexible link is causally specific rather than decorative: slack, tautness, pinned load, delayed proximal consequence, rebound, counterswing, and residual debt each change silhouette and body/support state. The result has a distinct visual sentence and refuses cheap reverse playback.
